sloka: सुमन्त्रस्तैर्नृपसुतै: सार्द्धमाश्वास्य राघवम् ।अवातारयदालम्ब्य नदीं मन्दाकिनीं शिवाम् ॥ २.१०२.२३॥
transliteration: sumantrastairnṛpasutai: sārddhamāśvāsya rāghavam ।avātārayadālambya nadīṁ mandākinīṁ śivām ॥ 2.102.23॥

translations.english: Thereafter, their constant follower Sumantra who was conversant in spiritual knowledge, a highminded person, softnatured, selfcontrolled, tranquilminded and staunchly devoted to Rama consoled him. Holding the hands of the princes, Sumantra helped their descent into the auspicious river Mandakini for taking bath.
